Bādari
mīm. teacher; ref. by Jaimini in Mīm. sūtras (III. i. 3. VI. 1. 27. IX. 2. 33. XIII. 3. 6); by Kātyāyana in Śrautasūtra IV. 3. 18. See Intro. to Tattvabindu p. 6.
He may be identical with the one ref. by Bādarāyaṇa in Brahmasūtra [Page255-b] (See next entry). He may be the son of one Badara. a. ancestor of Bādarāyaṇa.
See G. Jha, Pūrvamīmām3sā in its sources App. p.. 7-8.
